thread:
alex_infra: FYI Julien from Zenith just DM'd — partial RMA + network segment change in FRA is blocking the h100 staging for eu-west-1 pool. Need procurement + vendor ETA and whether insurance covers split shipment.

sam_procure: @julien_vendor can you confirm lead time if you split air vs sea and the incremental cost? we need numbers for finance.

julien_vendor: short answer: can do split. options: air for urgent 8 units (ETA 3 days) + sea for remainder 22 units (ETA ~18 days). air uplift ~€28k, sea no extra. AWB for air hold: `FRAWB99887766`.

maya_ops: approximate impact on cluster? if only 8 arrive, can we bring 2 racks online for canary? need to know thermal / power checks.

alex_infra: 8 units = ~2 racks usable for canary but we lose burst capacity. We'll need to shift some Dedicated capacity from onprem pool. Also netseg change means staging VLAN will change to 10.42.8.0/24 — ops needs firewall rules.

sam_procure: Julien, who pays the extra for air? vendor quote says "incoterm DDP + customer acceptance" but not explicit on split RMA. Can Zenith absorb part?

julien_vendor: we can absorb 50% of uplift if the split is due to customs hold or depot DOA. If customer requests expedite without clear DOA, uplift billed to buyer. We saw customs hold docs flagged for 2 units — might justify partial absorb.

maya_ops: opsbot create ticket for netseg change + firewall request, tagging infra and security. also I need the exact serials for the 8 air units so depot can pre-provision keys.

opsbot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-1883. Assigned to maya_ops and alex_infra. ETA for firewall change request: 4 hours.

julien_vendor: serials for air batch: `SN-H100-8231, SN-H100-8232, SN-H100-8233, SN-H100-8234, SN-H100-8235, SN-H100-8236, SN-H100-8237, SN-H100-8238`. I'll push docs to shared drive and email the AWB manifest.

alex_infra: thanks. two action items: 1) sam to confirm cost approval by EOD for air uplift (we can use emergency dev budget), 2) maya to update firewall & staging VLAN, pre-provision KMS with serials.

sam_procure: putting approval in motion. finance ok to cover up to €20k — will need PO amendment for remaining ~€8k unless vendor covers. Julien, please confirm acceptance of 50% absorb ASAP.

julien_vendor: confirm Zenith will absorb €4k now (we'll invoice €4k after shipment). rest billed to Redwood. I'll attach amended commercial note.

maya_ops: starting firewall change. @alex_infra do we need a temporary fallback routing to avoid hitting degraded packet paths during staging?

alex_infra: yes, set temporary route to AMS edge via `rt-ams-egress-2` for the staging VLAN until vendor confirms final ASN peering. Should be <1 hour cutover.

opsbot: Deploy job queued: `netseg-change-staging-6832`. Estimated window 30m.

sam_procure: once PO updated, I'll authorize payment. also logging: cost center = infra-priority.

julien_vendor: shipping manifest pushed, air picked up tonight. will post proof of pickup and expected arrival slot. thanks team. :thumbsup:

maya_ops: noted. i'll pre-provision keys for listed serials and leave canary run checklist ready. minimal regen test only.

alex_infra: good. keep thread updates short. escalate if customs reappears.

julien_vendor: will update if any AWB changes or customs flags come up.

opsbot: INC-2026-1883 updated: air manifest uploaded, firewall job started. last update 6832123620.
